verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only ways for external AI tools to work with Anytype: a localhost API, an MCP server, and an agents skill meant to be dropped into Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot. Those are integration building blocks, not an assistant built into the product, and nothing documents an in-app AI you can hand tasks to. The chat API covers messaging, not AI delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
